scope: Complete routed-expert MoE GPU call (FC1, activation, FC2, combine and backend adapters); excludes host enqueue, preparation, routing selection, shared experts, communication and serving. Synthetic H2048/I512/E512/K10 BF16 PowLU(m=2.5, limit=None), disjoint routes.
baseline: CUTLASS advertised stage search: rank each GEMM and retain the best two per stage, then validate all four compound pairs plus the heuristic. Frost ranks all 16 column pairs plus default. This is not an exhaustive search of all compound CUTLASS tactics.
numerical_contract: Independent FP64 dot references, BF16 intermediate/expert output, packed BF16 routing scores and ordered FP32 combine; each backend checked at 1% relative L2 / 3% normalized maximum. Not bitwise equality.
timing_notes: H100 uses external CUDA-event-delimited individual calls inside graph replay.

B200/B300 use globaltimer-delimited individual calls; empty stamp intervals are retained and not subtracted. Initial B300 CUDA-event results were coarsely quantized and are omitted from speedup claims.
Selection and validation use separate processes with source/environment equality checks. Forward and reverse capture order and duplicate A/A captures are retained.
retention: All selection candidates and validation medians; samples, graph reference errors and A/A controls for the two tuned paths. Default/fixed-FC2 diagnostic paths retain their medians, not every sample.
